title: Embedding Learning for Fine-grained Segmentation
summary: Tackled intra-class variation and class boundary ambiguity in segmentation by designing variation-aware proxy learning with a factorized similarity score and a focal-modulated compositional loss, delivering performance gains at no inference-time cost.
brief: Model-agnostic embedding factorization with variation-aware proxies for fine-grained segmentation.

title: Real-time LWIR Segmentation for Firefighter Navigation
summary: Led dataset construction, I2I-based thermal style augmentation, and the design of a noise-robust real-time segmentation framework with denoising, boundary enhancement, and multi-scale feature fusion for firefighter navigation in low-visibility environments.
brief: Noise-robust real-time LWIR segmentation for firefighter navigation with thermal style augmentation.

title: Building an Auto-Labeling Pipeline for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Built a text-prompt-based automated labeling pipeline for LWIR images using Grounding DINO and SAM, extended with class-wise inference, instance refinement, and stagewise failure handling to generate training-ready semantic label maps for 1,820 images with minimal manual correction.
brief: Text-prompt-based auto-labeling pipeline for LWIR semantic segmentation using Grounding DINO and SAM.

title: FiYS: Multimodal Shoes Search via Context Optimization
summary: A multimodal search engine identifying specific shoe features by combining image and text queries via learnable Context Optimization (CoOp), achieving over 93% retrieval accuracy.
brief: Multimodal retrieval with CoOp-based context tuning for accurate shoe search.
